description: This file defines a C# class 'Route' within the namespace 'BlazorAdmin.JavaScript'. The class encapsulates JavaScript interoperability, providing a method 'RouteOutside' to invoke a JavaScript function for routing outside the application context.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: A helper class for JavaScript interoperation related to routing, encapsulating the JS runtime dependency and exposing routing methods.

methods.name: RouteOutside
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a JavaScript function to change the route outside the Blazor application.
